content.introduction: According to Asia Financial, oil prices jumped by over 4%, while shares on the Kospi fell 9% with SK Hynix shares sinking by over 15%. The Asian Wall Street reported that Asian stock markets rose this week as investors bet on potential interest rate cuts by the US Federal Reserve, with Japan’s Nikkei and South Korea’s Kospi leading the gains. Bloomberg's commodities section showed mixed trends, with natural gas prices rising by 2.29% and gold prices falling by 0.87%.
